profile: conservative 35-root recovery copies; actual FEX allocator spills; not a natural/minimal-overhead profile
build_order: Populate a fresh pinned upstream tree with the exact retained dependency overlay.
sh tools/i3_producer/build.sh upstream build inside the pinned ARM64 Linux image.
No guest execution is part of this producer build.

entry_flags.nzcv: native NZCV; carry inverted at entry

excluded_prefix: ADR x0; STR x0,[x28,#0] writes FEX InlineJITBlockHeader. Body begins afterward; no FEX canonical-bank layout required.
publication_requirements: bind immutable code/maps and native spill frame lifetime
bind runtime-owned unchanged banks; metadata alone does not establish bank currency
preserve/restore return target: x30 is allocator scratch
admit aligned16byte same-page vector destination before faultable execution
map nativeFPSR sticky bits into admitted x86MXCSR status; upstream GetMXCSR is not used
